messages.author: ac86decb37f7fc72
messages.subject: Problems with setAccountInfo and proxy
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to set up my shinyapps account and it fails when pasting the setAccountInfo from the shinyapps  website. I am using a proxy server and have set that using set_config. I have also tried options(shinyapps.service_url = "http://api.shinyapps.io/v1") but that does not help either. In fact what ever I put in shinyapps.service_url does not show up in the error message. It always says api.shinyapps.io. Leading me do believe that the option setting is not what is used in the setAccountInfo function. Since it says host api.shinyapps.io in the error message and not the proxy I also assume that the function somehow does not use the proxy as it should from the set_config. Code snippet below. 

shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name='***',
                          token='*****',
                          secret='<SECRET>')
Error in function (type, msg, asError = TRUE)  : 
  Could not resolve host: api.shinyapps.io

Any help with this much appreciated

Regards

Andreas

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problems with setAccountInfo and proxy
parts:
Andreas,

Sounds like there is some confusion here so hopefully I can explain:

1) shinyapps.service_url has been deprecate in favor of shinyapps.shinyapps_url

2) I wouldn't change the URL to use insecure HTTP calls until we're sure your proxy server is correctly configured, and it still not working.

3) When you say "set_config", what function exactly are you referring to? Can you share the command?

Finally, have you read the docs in shinyapps::shinyappsProxies?
